points.K13: 发现电气隐患立即报告

shots.scene: 欣欣戴安全帽，举着一块空白记录板，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a safety helmet holds a blank clipboard and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 事故预防十二问，来测一测！

shots.scene: 车间里，阿杰第一天上岗，老李迎上来
shots.prompt_en: In a workshop, the young male student arrives for his first day and the facility engineer greets him.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天上岗。

shots.scene: 老李递给他一张空白答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands him a blank answer card.
shots.narration: 老李说：先答十二道事故预防题。

shots.scene: 答题卡上十二个空格
shots.prompt_en: A blank answer card with twelve empty boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 一共十二题，先自己选。

shots.scene: 答案卡片翻开的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an answer card flipping open. No people.
shots.narration: 每题之后，马上公布答案。

shots.scene: 事故爆炸图标旁四个选项
shots.prompt_en: An accident burst icon with four option cards. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：事故是什么样的？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，可以预防，而且代价高昂。

shots.scene: 阿杰手上贴着创可贴
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has a bandage on his hand.
shots.narration: 第二题：我出了事故或受了伤，应该？

shots.scene: 四个选项图标
shots.prompt_en: Four option icons: a wrench, a speech bubble to a supervisor, a person keeps working, a calendar with one week. No people.
shots.narration: 自己修好、告诉主管、继续干、一周内报。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，告诉你的主管。

shots.scene: 雨云、人、设备、方向牌四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a rain cloud, a person, a machine and a confusing direction sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：多数事故是什么造成的？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，人。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标旁四个选项
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon with four option cards. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：我怎样帮助预防事故？

shots.scene: 自带设备、培训证书、汽车、帮别人四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a personal toolbox, a training certificate, a car and two hands helping. No people.
shots.narration: 用自己的设备、只做受训的活、拼车、帮人干。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，只做我受过培训的工作。

shots.scene: 走道上散落的箱子和电线
shots.prompt_en: Boxes and a loose cord left on a walkway. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：多数滑倒绊倒是什么造成的？

shots.scene: 雨天、地上杂物、低头走路三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: rain, objects on the floor and a person walking while looking down at a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 下雨、地上和走道的杂物、走路不看前面。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，B和C都是。

shots.scene: 工具箱旁一个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon next to a toolbox. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：用工具的人必须怎样？

shots.scene: 小心、不戴眼镜、证书、不困四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a careful face, crossed-out glasses, a certificate with a stamp and an awake eye. No people.
shots.narration: 很小心、不戴眼镜、受训授权、别犯困。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，经过培训并获得授权。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头看着一台机器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head in front of a machine.
shots.narration: 第七题：不确定怎么干时，应该？

shots.scene: 问主管、乱试、问同事、放慢四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: asking a supervisor, trying random ways, asking a coworker and a snail. No people.
shots.narration: 问主管、换着试、问同事、慢慢干。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，问你的主管。

shots.scene: 咖啡杯、月亮、休息牌、主管图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a coffee cup, a moon with tired eyes, a break sign and a supervisor. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：哪种情况可能导致事故？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，上班前一晚没休息好。

shots.scene: 安全鞋、手套、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Safety shoes, gloves and safety glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：安全鞋、手套、护目镜等，

shots.scene: 四个选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four blank option cards with icons. No people.
shots.narration: 想戴才戴？某些工作的特定要求？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，某些工作有特定要求。

shots.scene: 一排安全标志
shots.prompt_en: A row of safety signs: a warning triangle, a caution sign and a danger sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：安全标志提供什么？

shots.scene: 三个标志依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three signs light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 危险区域信息、警示信息、警告。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，以上都是。

shots.scene: 车间里有人跌倒，阿杰看到
shots.prompt_en: In the workshop, the young male student sees a coworker icon fall down.
shots.narration: 第十一题：工作中看到事故，应该？

shots.scene: 找当事人聊、不管、同情、告诉主管
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: talking to the person, turning away, a sad face and telling a supervisor. No people.
shots.narration: 找当事人聊、不关我事、同情、告主管。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，告诉你的主管。

shots.section_title: 发现电气隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 破损的电线冒火花
shots.prompt_en: A damaged electrical cord with sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：看到电气隐患，应该？
overlay: 发现电气隐患立即报告

shots.section_title: 发现电气隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 立即报告、休息时修、不用设备、A和C
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: an alert bell, a wrench with a clock, a crossed-out plug and two combined cards. No people.
shots.narration: 立即报告、休息时自己修、不用、A和C。

shots.section_title: 发现电气隐患立即报告
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，立即报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 事故可预防，代价高，多数由人造成。

shots.scene: 阿杰和主管图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student next to a supervisor icon.
shots.narration: 受伤、看到事故、拿不准，都找主管。

shots.scene: 培训证书和月亮图标
shots.prompt_en: A training certificate icon next to a moon icon. No people.
shots.narration: 只做受训的活，上岗前休息好。

shots.scene: 防护用品和电线火花图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of protective gear and a sparking cord. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品按要求戴，电气隐患立即报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 事故预防十二问到这里，下次见！
